Entries.FrozenGeode_Description: Buni siz uchun temirchi ochib bera oladi.
Entries.FrozenGeodeStone_Description: Muzlagan geodalar olish uchun parchalab tashlang.
Entries.FrozenTear_Description: Afsonalarga ko‘ra, bu kristall yetining muzlab qolgan ko‘z yoshlaridan paydo bo‘lgan.
Entries.GalaxySoul_Description: Galaktika qurolining yakuniy shaklini ochish uchun unga shulardan 3 tasini toblang.
Entries.Garlic_Description: Taomlarga ajoyib o‘tkir ta’m qo‘shadi. Yuqori sifatli sarimsoq ancha achchiq bo‘lishi mumkin.
Entries.GemStone_Description: Tosh, ruda yoki geodalar olish uchun parchalab tashlang.
Entries.Geode_Description: Buni siz uchun temirchi ochib bera oladi.
Entries.GhostCrystal_Description: Bu kristall atrofida sovuq bir aura bor.
Entries.Ghostfish_Description: Yerosti ko‘llarida uchraydigan rangsiz, ko‘r baliq.
Entries.Ginger_Description: Bu o‘tkir, achchiq ildiz hayotiy quvvatni oshiradi, deb aytiladi.
Entries.GingerAle_Description: Oshqozonni tinchlantiruvchi ta’siri bilan mashhur o‘tkir ta’mli gazli ichimlik.
Entries.GlacierfishJr_Description: Asl muzlik balig‘ining o‘g‘li bor ekan...
Entries.GlassShards_Description: Asrlar davomida okean to‘lqinlari silliqlagan shisha siniqlari to‘plami. Ular qadimiy mozaika yoki marjonning qismlari bo‘lishi mumkin.
Entries.GlazedYams_Description: Shirin va to‘yimli... Shakar unga biroz karamel ta’mini beradi.
Entries.GlowstoneRing_Description: Doimiy yorug‘lik taratadi va buyumlarni yig‘ib olish doirangizni ham kengaytiradi.
Entries.Goby_Description: Buqa baliqlarining ayrim turlari sharsharalarga chiqib keta oladi.
Entries.GoldenAnimalCracker_Description: Mahsulot miqdorini doimiy ravishda ikki baravar oshirish uchun buni ferma hayvoniga bering. Cho‘chqalarga ta’sir qilmaydi.
Entries.GoldenCoconut_Description: Bu juda qattiq yong‘oq, ammo mutaxassis uni ochib bera olishi mumkin.
